description: Categorizes anomalies by type and severity; provides root cause analysis and impact assessment for each flag

classified_flags.title: string
recommended_actions: string

classified_flags.title: Budget Exceeded by 25% ($30,000 Overage)
classified_flags.description: The project budget was exceeded by 25%, resulting in a $30,000 overage.

root_cause.primary_factor: Ineffective budget controls and inaccurate forecasting.
contributing_factors: Potential scope creep or changes in requirements
root_cause.historical_pattern: Previous projects have also experienced moderate overspending, though not at this magnitude.

impact.operational: May require reprioritization or reduction of project scope; risk of funding shortfalls.
impact.compliance: Potential breach of client or grant funding agreements, raising regulatory and audit risks.

recommended_actions: Implement stricter budget tracking and regular variance analyses.
Review all unplanned expenses and categorize root causes.
Strengthen change control processes for scope modifications.
Conduct post-mortem to prevent recurrence.

classified_flags.title: Insurance Renewal 5 Days Overdue
classified_flags.description: Key insurance policy renewal has not been completed on time and is 5 days overdue, creating a temporary coverage gap.

root_cause.historical_pattern: Similar minor delays have occurred in prior renewals, typically resolved within one week.

impact.financial: Potential liability exposure if incident occurs during gap.
impact.operational: Business operations at risk if proof of insurance is required.
impact.compliance: Possible non-compliance with contractual or regulatory requirements.

recommended_actions: Renew insurance immediately and confirm reinstatement of coverage.
Implement automated reminders and escalation for renewals.
Review administrative workload and allocate backup resources.

classified_flags.title: Task C Review Delayed by 8 Days
classified_flags.description: The review for Task C was delayed by 8 days, impacting project timelines.

root_cause.historical_pattern: Task reviews are often delayed by a few days, although typically not to this extent.
root_cause.potential_cascading_effects: If such delays accumulate, overall project delivery can slip.

impact.financial: Minor cost impact from schedule slippage.
impact.operational: Potential cascading delays on dependent tasks.

recommended_actions: Set clear deadlines and assign task review owners.
Implement workflow automation where possible.
Monitor review timelines and follow up on delays.

aggregated_insights.trend_analysis: Current anomalies are distributed across budget, insurance, and operational domains with only the budget issue posing a high immediate risk.
systemic_patterns: Lack of strong proactive controls across financial and compliance processes.
Recurring minor delays indicating potential workflow bottlenecks.
